title: A Terminal for the Vector
author: Bram Yarrow
blurb: Elodie Coldharbour, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
